task_completion.description: The Weasis DICOM viewer is open and the radiograph (0002.DCM) is loaded in the main viewport.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible with a medical X-ray image displayed in the central viewing area.

task_completion.description: A 90-degree clockwise rotation is applied to the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image orientation in the viewport changes; the VLM should see the 'Rotate 90 CW' button being clicked or the image orientation indicator (e.g., 'R', 'L', 'S', 'I' markers) shifting 90 degrees clockwise.

task_completion.description: A horizontal flip (mirroring) is applied to the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image is mirrored horizontally; the VLM should see the 'Flip Horizontal' icon selected or the anatomical markers (e.g., 'L' becoming a mirrored 'L' or swapping sides) reflecting a flip.

task_completion.description: The user opens the export menu to save the transformed image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog box is visible over the Weasis interface.

task_completion.description: The export format is set to JPEG and the file path is specified.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the export dialog, 'JPEG' is selected as the format and the path '~/DICOM/exports/transformed_view.jpg' (or equivalent directory) is typed or selected.

task_completion.description: The export process is finalized and the file is saved.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog closes, and a success notification or the presence of the file in a file manager/terminal at the specified path is shown.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to perform transformations rather than command-line image processing tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis menu items or toolbar icons for rotation and flipping.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file to the target path.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the image being actively manipulated within the Weasis viewer before the export occurs.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Weasis application interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis UI elements (thumbnails, DICOM tags, transformation tools) are visible and responsive to agent actions.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a 90-degree clockwise rotation followed by a horizontal flip on file 0002.DCM. The final output must be a JPEG saved specifically to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/transformed_view.jpg. The VLM should verify that both transformations (rotate AND flip) were applied in the GUI before the export was triggered.
